name: crewkit
description: Plugins for running crews of Claude Code sessions on shared repos and hosts: working practices, shared-memory notices, and skills for the tools around them.

plugins.name: agent-practice
plugins.description: Skills and an always-on rules fragment for multi-session work on a shared repo and host: messaging and approvals, the Orchestrator, landing, independent review, host safety, secret-safe checks, crash recovery, herdr and bitc.

plugins.name: memory-notices
plugins.description: On top of claude-memsync: the shared memory index at session start, notices when a memory note changed on another machine, and a skill for working with memsync.

plugins.name: crew-lanes
plugins.description: Remediation lanes: one worktree and branch per lane, test-first implementation, gates, independent review and a gated land. In development.

plugins.name: crew-orchestrator
plugins.description: The coordinating session's tooling: a batch lander with every merge check (pinned heads, parent and tree verification, owner gates, high-risk PRs landed alone on an independent verdict), and the skill for running it. In development.
